nodes.label: Financial
nodes.description: Documents issued by or about companies and funds that report results or offer securities.

children.label: Annual report
children.description: A yearly report to shareholders covering a whole fiscal year, either a Form 10-K filing or a glossy annual report, with business overview, management discussion and audited financial statements. Not a 10-Q (partial year) or a standalone shareholder letter (a few pages of narrative only).

children.label: Quarterly report
children.description: An interim report covering a single quarter or half-year, such as a Form 10-Q or a quarterly or half-year report, with unaudited or reviewed financial statements and short management discussion. Not a press-release style earnings_release and not a full-year annual_report.

children.label: Shareholder letter
children.description: A letter from a company's management or an investment manager addressed to shareholders or investors that reviews performance and outlook in narrative prose, typically signed by the CEO, chairman or fund manager. Not a full annual_report with financial statements.

children.label: Earnings release
children.description: A short press release announcing quarterly or annual financial results, with headline figures, a business summary and condensed financial tables, usually 3 to 15 pages. Not a full quarterly_report or an investor_presentation slide deck.

children.label: Prospectus
children.description: A formal securities-offering or fund document describing an investment's objectives, risks, fees, and terms so investors can decide whether to buy, such as a mutual fund, ETF or IPO prospectus. Not an annual_report and not a marketing white_paper.

children.label: Proxy statement
children.description: A document sent to shareholders ahead of a shareholder meeting that describes the items to be voted on, the board nominees, executive compensation and governance, such as a Schedule 14A or DEF 14A. Not an annual_report even when it is bundled with one.

children.label: Fact sheet
children.description: A short (typically 1–4 page) periodic summary of a single fund or share class: objective, key facts, fees, performance table and chart, top holdings and allocation, as of a date. Not a full prospectus and not an annual report.

nodes.label: Legal
nodes.description: Documents that create, state or interpret legal rights and obligations.

children.label: Contract
children.description: A legally binding agreement between named parties, with recitals, defined terms, numbered clauses and signature blocks, such as a services, license, lease, employment or supply agreement. Not a public terms_policy that is posted unilaterally for all users.

children.label: Terms and policies
children.description: A unilaterally published set of terms of service, terms of use, privacy policy, cookie policy or acceptable-use policy that governs the public's use of a product or service. Not a negotiated contract between named parties.

children.label: Court opinion
children.description: A judicial decision issued by a court, including the syllabus, the majority opinion and any concurring or dissenting opinions, with case caption, docket number, holdings and reasoning. Not legislation and not a legal brief filed by a party.

children.label: Legislation
children.description: The text of enacted or proposed law, such as a statute, bill, act, treaty or administrative regulation, organized in titles, sections and subsections with enacting clauses. Not a court_opinion interpreting the law and not a government_report about it.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.description: Documents that report original research or formally specify technology.

children.label: Research paper
children.description: A scholarly paper reporting original research, with an abstract, introduction, methods, results and references, typically from arXiv, journals or conferences. Not an industry white_paper or a technical_standard.

children.label: Technical standard
children.description: A normative technical standard or specification, such as an RFC, IETF, W3C, ISO or IEEE document, that uses requirement keywords (MUST, SHOULD) to define a protocol, format or interface precisely. Not a vendor datasheet or a user_manual.

children.label: White paper
children.description: An industry, vendor, consultancy or think-tank report that argues for a position, explains a topic or presents analysis aimed at a professional audience, without being peer-reviewed or normative. Not a research_paper (academic) or a government_report (issued by an agency).

nodes.label: Technical
nodes.description: Product documentation describing how to use or select a hardware or software product.

children.label: User manual
children.description: Task-oriented documentation that guides an end user or administrator through installing, configuring, operating and troubleshooting a product, with chapters, procedures and a table of contents. Not a datasheet, which lists specifications rather than procedures.

children.label: Datasheet
children.description: A concise specification document for a hardware component or product, with features, pin or port descriptions, electrical or performance characteristics, ordering information and package details, normally from the manufacturer. Not a procedural user_manual.

nodes.label: Government
nodes.description: Documents published by public institutions in their official capacity.

children.label: Government report
children.description: A report published by a government agency, central bank, legislative office or audit office, presenting analysis, findings, monetary policy, oversight results or recommendations to policymakers and the public. Not legislation itself and not a think-tank white_paper.

nodes.label: Corporate
nodes.description: Documents a company publishes to communicate non-statutory information about itself.

children.label: Sustainability report
children.description: A company report on environmental, social and governance (ESG), sustainability, climate or impact performance, with metrics, targets and frameworks such as GRI, SASB or TCFD. Not a financial annual_report, although the two are sometimes combined.

children.label: Investor presentation
children.description: A slide deck prepared for investors and analysts, such as an earnings call presentation or investor day deck, laid out as landscape slides with short bullets, charts and forward-looking-statement disclaimers. Not a prose earnings_release.
